title: Locked Outer Mirrors with Fixed Cavity - Reduced DOF Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Locking outermost DBR mirror pairs to exact quarter-wave optical thicknesses while fixing the central cavity at λ/2 will reduce search space dimensionality and accelerate phase alignment, improving convergence toward the 0.95 transmittance target without sacrificing stopband suppression.
design_principle: Fabry-Perot interferometer with quarter-wave DBR mirrors (HL)^N D(LH)^N structure. Outer 3 pairs per side fixed at QWOT, inner 2 pairs per side + cavity optimizable. Cavity initialized to exactly 360.0 nm (Ta2O5 half-wave at 1550 nm).
proposed_topology: exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers)
design_variables: thicknesses of layers 7-10 and 12-15 (8 optimizable layers)
manufacturing_considerations: Fixed outer layers simplify deposition monitoring
theory_basis: Quarter-wave DBR theory: nH*dH = nL*dL = λ0/4 for maximum reflectance bandwidth
Defect cavity theory: half-wave defect layer creates transmission resonance within stopband
Phase matching: fixed outer mirrors provide stable boundary conditions for cavity resonance
expected_advantages: Reduced optimization dimensionality (8 vs 21 variables) accelerates convergence
Fixed QWOT outer mirrors guarantee minimum stopband performance
Fixed cavity ensures resonance condition at launch
known_risks: Reduced DOF may limit ability to fine-tune passband shape
Fixed cavity thickness may not be optimal if material indices differ from assumed values
May not achieve full 0.95 transmittance if mirror reflectance insufficient
execution_request_english: Design a 21-layer Fabry-Perot bandpass filter on Fused Silica substrate with Air incident medium using Ta2O5 and SiO2. Layer sequence: Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2 (layers 1-6 fixed QWOT) | Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2 (layers 7-10 optimizable) | Ta2O5 cavity (layer 11 fixed at 360.0 nm) | SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O2 (layers 12-15 optimizable) | SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5 (layers 16-21 fixed QWOT). Initialize fixed QWOT layers: Ta2O5 at 184.5 nm, SiO2 at 267.2 nm (quarter-wave at 1550 nm). Optimize layers 7-10 and 12-15 with bounds 50-450 nm. Evaluate transmittance spectrum from 1400-1700 nm. Target: maximize T at 1550 nm, suppress T in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 5 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs, one cavity layer, and exactly 5 reverse-order pairs (21 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1400-1500 nm, 1550-1550 nm, 1600-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance at 1550 nm (soft target ≥ 0.95); strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 1400-1500 nm; transmittance in 1600-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive: lock outermost mirror pairs to fixed QWOT, fix cavity at 360.0 nm, restrict optimizer to inner 15 layers (actually 8 optimizable + 1 fixed cavity + 12 fixed outer = 21 total). Reduces search dimensionality from 21 to 8 variables while preserving Fabry-Perot principle from route_01.
